messages:
mara: Heads up — SIEM alert: audit deliveries dropped ~09:12 UTC after the egress fw tighten.
ton y: saw that. which stream is impacted? CloudTrail or flowlogs?
mara: Both. uploader logs show S3 PutObject 403 + intermittent KMS Decrypt denied.
eli: can you paste the error snippet?
mara: `ERROR: uploader.PutObject failed: AccessDenied (kms:Decrypt)\n\tat uploader/s3.go:87`
devops-bot: fw-update deployed at 09:10 by tony (change-id: infra/patch-4321).
olga: SOC is seeing gaps. we need either a rollback or a scoped exception — audit integrity > perf here.
sam: least risky: open outbound 443 from the uploader subnet to S3 + STS + KMS endpoints only. avoids full rollback.
tony: current rule is default-deny outbound. I can add a temporary allow for `logs-uploader` role IPs -> S3/KMS/STS endpoints. will need fast-track review.
nina: quick cost check: backlog reingest ~200GB estimated — approx $15-$30 in PUT + SIEM ingestion. OK from finance?
olga: yes approve. compliance wants complete reingest.
mara: Proposed playbook (short):
1) Add temporary egress allow: uploader subnet -> s3.amazonaws.com, sts.amazonaws.com, kms.amazonaws.com (443)
2) Validate canary PUTs (5 samples) succeed
3) Kick reingest job for gap window and tail SIEM ingestion metrics
4) Revert egress rule after catch-up & run postmortem

sam: Canary command to validate: `aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-audit-canary --key canary.json --body - <<'JSON'
{"time":"2024-03-12T09:15:00Z","canary":"ok"}
JSON`

eli: ran canary from a bastion in the uploader subnet — PUT succeeded after adding the allow.
tony: creating PR for the fw rule change and tagging `#audit-urgent` for fast review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321 (draft).
mara: note: STS sessions were also timing out because the STS endpoint was blocked; include STS in the allow list.

devops-bot: PR created and flagged as emergency. permissions reviewers: @olga @sam.
sam: on-call will standby for rollback. ETA for change: ~8m.
tony: patch applied. monitoring CloudTrail S3 PUT success rate now showing >99% for the last 2m.
mara: starting reingest: `scripts/reingest_audit.sh --since 2024-03-12T09:00Z --to 2024-03-12T09:30Z`

eli: first batch of reingested files accepted by SIEM. counts incrementing.

nina: opened finance ticket TICKET-4021 to track the reingest cost and retention bump.
olga: good work. requirement: update runbook to include scoped egress exception as an allowed emergency fallback and document approval flow.
mara: agreed — will file runbook PR and postmortem entry. closing thread after final confirmation of catch-up. :white_check_mark:
